name: F-99 radon gunship
description: The F-99 radon gunship was a class of gunship. In 18 BBY, Cli Pastayra of the Wandering Star syndicate deployed a pair of F-99s in a confrontation with Fyzen Gor and his organic-augmented droids on Utapau. By 7 ABY, those models were still in use in order to protect the Phylanx Redux Transmitter while in the Mesulan Remnants Belt.
